title: NCAA: Torculas shines as San Beda spoils JRU’s unbeaten record
summary: Aldous Torculas shone as San Beda University spoiled Jose Rizal University’s unbeaten record with a 65-62 victory in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Saturday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
